WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001))
  ) AS "time"
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT metric
  FROM (
    VALUES ('local'), ('global')
  ) AS m(metric)
),
data AS (
SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
       venue AS metric,
       SUM(jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(book->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)))::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  VALUES ('local', e.payload->'local'), ('global', e.payload->'global')
) AS v(venue, book)
WHERE e.topic = '${target_books_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'JointTargetBook'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND book IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
)
SELECT b."time", m.metric, COALESCE(d.value, 0.0) AS value
FROM buckets b
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN data d
  ON d."time" = b."time"
 AND d.metric = m.metric
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001))
  ) AS "time"
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT metric
  FROM (
    VALUES ('local bid'), ('local ask'), ('global bid'), ('global ask')
  ) AS m(metric)
),
data AS (
SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time", (venue || ' ' || CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(o->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END) AS metric,
       SUM(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END) AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  VALUES ('local', e.payload->'local'), ('global', e.payload->'global')
) AS v(venue, book)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(book->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS o
WHERE e.topic = '${target_books_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'JointTargetBook'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, venue, CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(o->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END
ORDER BY 1
)
SELECT b."time", m.metric, COALESCE(d.value, 0.0) AS value
FROM buckets b
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN data d
  ON d."time" = b."time"
 AND d.metric = m.metric
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH expanded AS (
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
         e.ts,
         (book.role || ' ' ||
          COALESCE(book.value->>'exchange', e.exchange, 'unknown') || ' ' ||
          COALESCE(book.value->>'symbol', e.symbol, 'unknown') || ' ' ||
          CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END || ' #' || o.order_no::text) AS metric,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES ('local', e.payload->'local'), ('global', e.payload->'global')
  ) AS book(role, value)
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(book.value->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS o(value, order_no)
  WHERE e.topic = '${target_books_topic}'
    AND e.event_type = 'JointTargetBook'
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND book.value IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
),
latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON ("time", metric)
         "time",
         metric,
         value
  FROM expanded
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY "time", metric, ts DESC
)
SELECT "time", metric, value
FROM latest
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001))
  ) AS "time"
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT metric
  FROM (
    VALUES
      ('target orders'),
      ('risk passed'),
      ('kept live'),
      ('cancel commands'),
      ('new order candidates'),
      ('valid new orders'),
      ('exchange accepted')
  ) AS m(metric)
),
data AS (
SELECT
  to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
  flow.metric,
  SUM(flow.value) AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  VALUES
    ('target orders', CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','target_book','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','target_book','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END),
    ('risk passed', CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','risk_approved_target','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','risk_approved_target','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END),
    ('kept live', CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','kept','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','kept','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END),
    ('cancel commands', CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','planned_cancel','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','planned_cancel','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END),
    ('new order candidates', CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','planned_place','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','planned_place','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END),
    ('valid new orders', CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','rules_valid','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','rules_valid','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END),
    ('exchange accepted', CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','router_accepted','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','router_accepted','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END)
) AS flow(metric, value)
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
GROUP BY 1, 2
)

WITH drops AS (
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
         drop_stage.metric,
         GREATEST(drop_stage.before_count - drop_stage.after_count, 0.0) AS value
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      ('venue limits'::text, CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','ladder','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','ladder','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END, CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','venue_quantized','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','venue_quantized','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END),
      ('order shaping'::text, CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','venue_quantized','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','venue_quantized','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END, CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','capped','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','capped','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END)
  ) AS drop_stage(metric, before_count, after_count)
  WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
)
SELECT "time", metric, SUM(value) AS value
FROM drops
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

WITH role_rejections AS (
SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
       ('risk: ' || reason.key) AS metric,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(reason.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(reason.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(
  COALESCE(
    e.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline','risk_approved_target','rejection_counts'],
    e.payload #> ARRAY['risk','rejection_counts'],
    '{}'::jsonb
  )
) AS reason(key, value)
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  AND (reason.key LIKE 'global_%'
       OR reason.key IN ('missing_global_market_data', 'stale_global_market_data', 'missing_global_ledger'))

)
SELECT "time", metric, SUM(value) AS value
FROM role_rejections
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
       blocked.reason AS metric,
       COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
  COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)
) AS gate(key, value)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(
  COALESCE(gate.value->'blocked_reasons', '[]'::jsonb)
) AS blocked(reason)
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  AND COALESCE(gate.value->>'role', '') = 'local'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
       blocked.reason AS metric,
       COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
  COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)
) AS gate(key, value)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(
  COALESCE(gate.value->'blocked_reasons', '[]'::jsonb)
) AS blocked(reason)
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  AND COALESCE(gate.value->>'role', '') = 'global'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
